question: Nico controls Analia's [Bane Alley Blackguard] enchanted with their [Corrupted Conscience]. Analia casts their own [Lay Claim], targeting Nico's Corrupted Conscience. After it resolves, who controls the Bane Alley Blackguard? Who controls the Corrupted Conscience?
answer_gold: Analia controls both permanents. Out of the two auras, Corrupted Conscience has the earlier timestamp, and would normally be applied first. However, the effects from both auras apply in the same layer, applying the Lay Claim's effect would change how the Corrupted Conscience's effect is applied, and applying the Corrupted Conscience's effect would not change how the Lay Claim's effect is applied, so the Corrupted Conscience's effect is dependent on the Lay Claim's effect. The Lay Claim's effect applies first, giving Analia control of Corrupted Conscience, and then the Corrupted Conscience's effect applies, giving Analia control of Bane Alley Blackguard.

question: Alan controls [Iroas, God of Victory] and 3 other enchantments. Their devotion to white is 2. They cast [Starfield of Nyx]. After it resolves, is Iroas, God of Victory a creature? If so, what are its power and toughness?
answer_gold:
Iroas, God of Victory is a creature with power and toughness equal to its mana value.

In the type layer, there are 2 effects that impact Iroas, God of Victory's type. They are applied in timestamp order, so first Iroas, God of Victory's effect causes Iroas, God of Victory to not be a creature, then Starfield of Nyx's ability causes Iroas, God of Victory to become a creature.

In the power/toughness setting layer, Starfield of Nyx's effect sets Iroas, God of Victory's power and toughness equal to its mana value.

question: Alex activates [Inkmoth Nexus] to turn it into a creature and attacks Nadia with it. Nadia doesn't block it and then casts [Summoning Trap], putting [Melira, Sylvok Outcast] onto the battlefield. What happens during the combat damage step?
answer_gold:
Inkmoth Nexus's ability gives it infect, and Melira, Sylvok Outcast's effect makes it lose infect. The effects are applied in timestamp order, so Inkmoth Nexus does not have infect. Nadia will lose 1 life when damage is dealt.

(There is no dependency here because neither effect changes the text or the existence of the other, what it applies to, or what it does to any of the things it applies to.)

question: Nathaniel controls a [Melira, Sylvok Outcast]. Ari activates [Inkmoth Nexus] to turn it into a creature and attacks Nathaniel with it. Nathaniel doesn't block. What happens during the combat damage step?
answer_gold: Melira, Sylvok Outcast's effect makes Inkmoth Nexus lose infect and Inkmoth Nexus's ability gives it infect. The effects are applied in timestamp order, so Inkmoth Nexus has infect. When damage is dealt, Nathaniel can't get a poison counter, so nothing happens.

question: Autumn controls [Painter's Servant] naming "blue" and [Sword of Body and Mind]. Nico casts [Gift of Tusks] targeting the Painter's Servant. After it resolves, what happens if Autumn tries to equip Painter's Servant with Sword of Body and Mind?
answer_gold:
It becomes equipped and then becomes unequipped.

Gift of Tusks makes Painter's Servant lose all abilities, but this happens after color-changing effects have applied, so all cards are still blue. Nothing prevents the Sword of Body and Mind from becoming attached to Painter's Servant. Once Sword of Body and Mind is equipped to the Painter's Servant, it has protection from blue (the effect removing its abilities is applied before the effect giving it protection from blue, and so can't be equipped by anything blue. It becomes unattached as a state-based action.

question: Nathanael controls [Grizzly Bears] and [Muraganda Petroglyphs]. They cast and resolve [Crowd's Favor], targeting Grizzly Bears. Amia then casts [Archetype of Courage]. After it resolves, what are the power and toughness of Grizzly Bears?
answer_gold: 5/4. In layer 6, Archetype of Courage makes Crowd's Favor unable to grant first strike to Grizzly Bears. Archetype of Courage isn't granting any abilities to Grizzly Bears itself, so in layer 7 Grizzly Bears has no abilities and gets +2/+2 from Muraganda Petroglyphs and +1/+0 from Crowd's Favor.

question: Albert controls [Life and Limb], [Blood Moon], and [Murmuring Bosk], that entered the battlefield in that order. Is Murmuring Bosk a creature?
answer_gold: No. Applying Blood Moon's effect would prevent Life and Limb's effect from applying to Murmuring Bosk and applying Life and Limb's effect first would not affect how Blood Moon's effect is applied or what it does, so Life and Limb's effect is dependent on Blood Moon's effect and waits to apply until afterwards. Since Blood Moon's effect makes Murmuring Bosk no longer a Forest, Life and Limb doesn't apply to it at all.

question: Angelica controls a [Blood Moon], a [Life and Limb], and a [Sheltered Thicket], that entered the battlefield in that order. Is the Sheltered Thicket a creature?
answer_gold: No. Applying Blood Moon's effect first would prevent Life and Limb's effect from applying to Sheltered Thicket and applying Life and Limb's effect first would not affect how Blood Moon's effect is applied or what it does, so Life and Limb's effect is dependent on Blood Moon's effect and waits to apply until afterwards. Since Blood Moon's effect makes Sheltered Thicket no longer a Forest, Life and Limb doesn't apply to it at all.

question: Alfred controls a [Blood Moon], a [Life and Limb], and a 1/1 Green Saproling Creature token, that entered the battlefield in that order. What is the Saproling?
answer_gold: It's a 1/1 green Land Creature - Mountain Saproling with "{T}: Add {R}.". Applying Life and Limb's effect would allow Blood Moon's effect to apply to the Saproling, but applying Blood Moon's effect first would not affect how Life and Limb's effect is applied or what it does. Blood Moon's effect is therefore dependent on Life and Limb's effect and waits to apply until afterwards. Since Life and Limb's effect makes the Saproling a nonbasic land, Blood Moon then applies and turns it into a Mountain with "{T}: Add {R}." and no other abilities.

question: Alex controls a [Life and Limb], a [Blood Moon], and a 1/1 Green Saproling Creature token, that entered the battlefield in that order. What is the Saproling?
answer_gold: It's a 1/1 green Land Creature - Mountain Saproling with "{T}: Add {R}.". Applying Life and Limb's effect would allow Blood Moon's effect to apply to the Saproling and applying Blood Moon's effect first would not affect how Life and Limb's effect is applied or what it does, so Blood Moon's effect is dependent on Life and Limb's effect and waits to apply until afterwards. Since Life and Limb's effect makes the Saproling a nonbasic land, Blood Moon then applies and turns it into a Mountain with "{T}: Add {R}." and no other abilities.

question: Aubriella controls a [Life and Limb], a [Blood Moon], a [Sapseep Forest], and a 1/1 Green Saproling Creature token, that entered the battlefield in that order. What do the Sapseep Forest and Saproling look like?
answer_gold:
Applying Life and Limb's effect first would allow Blood Moon's effect to apply to the Saproling, and applying Blood Moon's effect first would prevent Life and Limb from applying to the Sapseep Forest, so both effects are dependent on each other and those dependencies are ignored. Life and Limb has the earlier timestamp, so it's applied first.

As Life and Limb's effect is applied, Sapseep Forest becomes a creature and the Saproling becomes a land. Then as Blood Moon's effect is applied, they both lose their other land types and abilities and becomes Mountains.

Both permanents are 1/1 Green Land Creature - Mountain Saprolings, with "{T}: Add {R}".

question: Ainsley controls a [Blood Moon], a [Life and Limb], a [Cinder Glade], and a 1/1 Green Saproling Creature token, that entered the battlefield in that order. What do the Cinder Glade and Saproling look like?
answer_gold:
Cinder Glade is a noncreature Land - Mountain with "{T}: Add {R}." and no other abilities. The Saproling is a 1/1 Green Land Creature - Forest Saproling with "{T}: Add {G}." and no other abilities.

Applying Life and Limb's effect first would allow Blood Moon's effect to apply to the Saproling, and applying Blood Moon's effect first would prevent Life and Limb from applying to the Cinder Glade, so both effects are dependent on each other and those dependencies are ignored. Blood Moon has the earlier timestamp, so it's applied first.

As Blood Moon's effect is applied, Cinder Glade becomes a Mountain and loses the "Forest" subtype. Then Life and Limb's effect is applied, making the Saproling into a land.

question: Alannah controls [Ore-Rich Stalactite], [Life and Limb], [March of the Machines], and [Xenograft] naming "Saproling", that entered the battlefield in that order. What is the Ore-Rich Stalactite?
answer_gold:
It's a 2/2 colorless Artifact Creature - Saproling.

In layer 4, Life and Limb's effect is not dependent on March of the Machines or Xenograft, so Life and Limb is applied first, then March of the Machines, then Xenograft. Since Life and Limb didn't apply to Ore-Rich Stalactite in layer 4, it doesn't apply to it in later layers either.

question: Ainsley controls [Furycalm Snarl], [Humility], [Magus of the Moon], and [Crosis's Catacombs] that entered the battlefield in that order. What are the characteristics of the Furycalm Snarl and Crosis's Catacombs?
answer_gold: They are both Mountains with no abilities other than "{T}: Add {R}". Magus of the Moon's effect applies in layer 4, while Humility's effect applies in layer 6 and 7. Magus of the Moon is a 1/1 with no abilities, but it still turns nonbasic lands into Mountains.

question: Aiden controls [Volrath's Shapeshifter] and [Yixlid Jailer]. The top card of their graveyard is [Mistform Skyreaver]. Does Volrath's Shapeshifter have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. Yixlid Jailer only removes abilities, not text, and text is what Volrath's Shapeshifter cares about. Volrath's Shapeshifter also gains the text of the Mistform Skyreaver before Yixlid Jailer removes the abilities.

question: Nickolas controls [Dryad Arbor]. Aniya casts [Overwhelming Splendor], enchanting Nickolas. After it resolves, can Nickolas tap the Dryad Arbor for {G}?
answer_gold: No. It has the ability to tap for {G} due to its basic land subtype, and it loses it in layer 6.

question: Nico controls [Yixlid Jailer]. Achilles uses [Past in Flames] to give [Deadly Complication] in their graveyard Flashback. Is Achilles able to cast Deadly Complication from their graveyard to destroy Yixlid Jailer?
answer_gold: Yes. Both Yixlid Jailer and Past in Flames are applying a continuous effect to Deadly Complication, and both are being applied in layer 6. Since there is no dependency between the two effects, they are applied in timestamp order; Yixlid Jailer removes all abilities from Deadly Complication, which is then given flashback by Past in Flames.

question: Aspen controls [Watchwolf] enchanted by [Lignify], [Figure of Destiny] that's had its third ability activated, and [Swab Goblin]. They casts [Pack's Favor] targeting Swab Goblin. After that resolves, they casts [Mirrorweave] targeting Figure of Destiny. What are the characteristics of Swab Goblin and Watchwolf?
answer_gold:
Watchwolf is a 0/4 Treefolk with no abilities. Swab Goblin is a 4/4 Kithikin with Figure of Destiny's printed abilities (not flying or first strike).

Mirrorweave confers Figure of Destiny's copiable values to the other cards. This doesn't include the type and text-changing effects that are currently applying to it. Watchwolf will become a 1/1 in layer 1 but then will have its power and toughness changed in layer 7. Swab Goblin is in a similar situation, copy effects will be applied in layer 1. Pack's Favor will be applied later in layer 7c.

question: Allison controls [Dralnu's Crusade] and [Leopard-Spotted Jiao]. Allison then casts [Conspiracy] naming "Goblin". What are the creature types of Leopard-Spotted Jiao and does it get +1/+1?
answer_gold: Leopard-Spotted Jiao is a black Goblin Zombie in addition to its other types and does get +1/+1. Dralnu's Crusade is dependent on Conspiracy, because applying Conspiracy first changes the set of permanents Dralnu's Crusade would apply to. Because of this, Conspiracy's effect is applied first, and then Dralnu's Crusade's effect.

question: Alaina has seven cards in their hand and controls [Recycle]. They cast [Trusted Advisor]. After that resolves, what is Alaina's maximum hand size?
answer_gold: Four. Recycle sets the maximum hand size to two, and Trusted Advisor then modifies that maximum hand size by adding two to it.

question: Alisson controls [Quickening Licid], [March of the Machines], and [Mycosynth Lattice] that entered the battlefield in that order. They activate Quickening Licid's ability targeting itself. What happens?
answer_gold: Quickening Licid becomes an Aura enchantment with enchant creature. It cannot become attached to itself because it is no longer a creature. When state-based actions are checked, it will be put into the graveyard.

question: Aya controls a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 3 +1/+1 counters on it. Nico casts [Duplicant] and has it exile Skullbriar, the Walking Grave. What are Duplicant's power and toughness after the imprint ability resolves?
answer_gold: Duplicant is a 1/1. Duplicant has a non-characteristic defining ability that sets its power and toughness. This is applied in layer 7b, at which point Skullbriar, the Walking Grave's power and toughness is still 1/1 because power and toughness changes from counters are not applied until layer 7c.
submitter: Cris Plyler and Minh-Duc Vu (via JudgingFTW)

question: Abel attacks with [Pristine Angel]. While it's tapped, Nico activates [Cephalid Snitch]'s ability targeting Pristine Angel. After that resolves, Abel casts a spell and untaps Pristine Angel. Can Nico now target the Pristine Angel with [Murder]?
answer_gold:
Yes. "Protection from all colors" is shorthand for protection from each color individually. It loses protection from black, and still has protection from all the other colors.

(The timestamp of Pristine Angel's ability does not change when it becomes untapped.)

question: Alijah controls [Badlands] and [Conversion]. Alijah then casts [Magus of the Moon]. After that resolves, what color(s) of mana can Badlands tap for?
answer_gold: Only {R}. Both Magus of the Moon and Conversion only apply in layer 4. The effects are applied in timestamp order, resulting in Conversion applying first to make Badlands a Plains, then Magus of the Moon applies making it a Mountain.

question: Adriel controls [Wandering Ones] equipped with [Fleetfeather Sandals]. On Nico's turn, they enchant it with [Tightening Coils]. On Adriel's next turn, they activate Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability, targeting Wandering Ones. After that resolves, does it have flying?
answer_gold: No. Tightening Coils has the most recent timestamp, so its effect is applied last. Activating Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability targeting Wandering Ones doesn't change its timestamp.

question: Ari controls [Bludgeon Brawl] and [Soldevi Digger]. They cast [Titania's Song]. Once it resolves, what are the characteristics of Soldevi Digger?
answer_gold: It's a 2/2 artifact creature with no abilities. Applying Titania's Song would cause Bludgeon Brawl to no longer apply (since Soldevi Digger would be a creature). However, applying Bludgeon Brawl would not change how Titania's Song's effect is applied, so Bludgeon Brawl is dependent on Titania's Song. Titania's Song applies first, and then Bludgeon Brawl won't affect Soldevi Digger since it's a creature.

question: Ariah controls [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Nickolas casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics after Turn to Frog resolves?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 blue Frog with no abilities. Wayward Angel's last ability begins to apply in layer 5. It's removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply, it will continue doing so in later layers. Wayward Angel has the earlier timestamp, so it gives itself trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature" before Turn to Frog removes its abilities in layer 6.

question: Ariella controls a manifested [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Nathaniel casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. After that resolves, Ariella turns Wayward Angel face up. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics afterwards?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 black Frog with trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature", but no other abilities. Wayward Angel receives a new timestamp when it turns face up, so its ability is applied before Turn to Frog in each layer. Wayward Angel's last ability is removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply in layer 5 to change its color to black, it will continue doing so in later layers. Turn to Frog has the earlier timestamp, so it makes Wayward Angel blue before it becomes black in layer 5 and removes Wayward Angel's abilities in layer 6 before it gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature".

question: Ahmad controls [Conspiracy] (naming "Ferret"), [Kormus Bell], [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth], and a [Vastwood Zendikon] enchanting Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth that entered the battlefield in that order. Is Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth a creature? If so, what are its creature types?
answer_gold: It is an Elemental Ferret creature. Conspiracy has the earliest timestamp, but it's dependent on Vastwood Zendikon, and waits to apply until after Vastwood Zendikon is applied. Kormus Bell is dependent on Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, so Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth is applied first, then Kormus Bell. At this point Conspiracy is no longer be dependent on Vastwood Zendikon, so Conspiracy is applied, and then Vastwood Zendikon. Since Vastwood Zendikon says that Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth is still a land, it retains its prior creature type of "Ferret" when it becomes an Elemental.

question: Andre controls [Raugrin Triome] and [Prismatic Omen]. Nala casts [Blood Moon]. After it resolves, what land types does Raugrin Triome have?
answer_gold: Just Mountain. Blood Moon and Prismatic Omen's effects are not dependent on each other, so they are applied in timestamp order.

question: Ariel controls [Frostboil Snarl] and [Blood Moon]. They cast [Prismatic Omen]. After it resolves, what land types does Frostboil Snarl have?
answer_gold: All 5. Prismatic Omen and Blood Moon's effects are not dependent on each other, so they are are applied in timestamp order.

question: Adan restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. Adan puts [Blood Moon], [Prismatic Omen] and [Winged Temple of Orazca] onto the battlefield with Karn Liberated. What colors of mana can Winged Temple of Orazca tap for?
answer_gold: Adan gets to choose their relative timestamp order as they are put onto the battlefield. Winged Temple of Orazca will either be able to tap for any color or just {R} depending on Adan's choice.

question: Apollo controls [Realmwright] naming "Island", [Arcane Adaptation] naming "Saproling", and [Life and Limb], which entered the battlefield in that order. What are the types and subtypes of Realmwright?
answer_gold:
Realmwright is a 1/1 green Land Creature - Vedalken Wizard Saproling Forest.

All three cards have effects in layer 4, the type changing layer. The game first looks at Realmwright's effect since it's first in timestamp order, sees that it's not dependent on Arcane Adaptation nor on Life and Limb, and applies it. Next the game looks at Arcane Adaptation's effect, sees that it's not dependent on Life and Limb, and applies it, followed by Life and Limb last.

Life and Limb lets it keep its original creature types, but not its original colors.

question: Ainsley controls [Leyline of Singularity] and [Awoken Demon] equipped with [Helm of the Host]. When the trigger from Helm of the Host resolves, will the created token be legendary?
answer_gold: Yes. When Helm of the Host goes to create the token of Awoken Demon it will see that it is legendary, and create a token that does not have the legendary supertype. However Leyline of Singularity is generating a continuous effect in layer 4, which will overwrite the base characteristics of any object on the battlefield, regardless of when it entered, making it legendary.

question: Addison controls [Dryad of the Ilysian Grove] and casts [Blood Moon]. What are the characteristics of [Snow-Covered Island], [Study Hall], [Dryad Arbor], and [Mountain] after Blood Moon resolves?
answer_gold:
Snow-Covered Island and Mountain have all basic land subtypes: "Plains", "Island", "Swamp", "Mountain", and "Forest". Dryad of the Ilysian Grove doesn't change supertypes and Blood Moon affects nonbasic lands.

Study Hall has subtype Mountain. There are no dependencies between Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Blood Moon, so we apply the type-changing effects in timestamp order.

Dryad Arbor is now a Creature Land - Dryad Mountain. Gaining a basic land type doesn't remove other card types or nonland subtypes.

question: Angelina has seven cards in their hand, controls [Trusted Advisor], and casts [Null Profusion]. After Angelina discards at the end of the turn, how many cards should they have in their hand?
answer_gold: Two. Trusted Advisor adds two to the maximum hand size (making it nine), and Null Profusion then sets the maximum hand to two.

question: Nico controls [Thespian's Stage] that's currently a copy of [Temple of Triumph]. Alayna casts [Alpine Moon] and names "Temple of Triumph" as it resolves. Alayna then activates a second Thespian's Stage targeting Temple of Triumph. What does each Thespian's Stage look like?
answer_gold: Both Thespian's Stages are lands named "Temple of Triumph" and have "{T}: Add one mana of any color." and no other abilities. Because Thespian's Stage gains its ability as part of the copying process, the ability applies in the copy layer, which is earlier than the adding and removing abilities layer.

question: Allen controls [Thraben Purebloods] which is enchanted by [Kenrith's Transformation]. Thraben Purebloods then becomes enchanted by [One with the Stars]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Thraben Purebloods becomes an enchantment with no abilities and with the color dictated by Kenrith's Transformation. When state-based actions are checked, Kenrith's Transformation is attached to an illegal target and is put into the graveyard. Thraben Purebloods then regains all characteristics except its type is only enchantment. State-based actions are checked again. Nothing happens, and Allen gets priority.

This is an interaction of continuous effects, so the layers will need to be considered. In this case, no changes occur until layer four. There are two effects occurring in this layer, so timestamps will need to be considered. Since Kenrith's Transformation was attached first, Thraben Purebloods maintains its status as a creature. Then, One with the Stars turns Thraben Purebloods into an enchantment and removes all other types. Thraben Purebloods is changed to the color dictated by Kenrith's Transformation in layer five. Thraben Purebloods loses all abilities in layer six due to Kenrith's Transformation. Lastly, Thraben Purebloods has its power and toughness set to the values stated in Kenrith's Transformation in layer seven. When state-based actions are checked, Kenrith's Transformation is attached to an enchantment and is put into the graveyard. State-based actions are checked again, and nothing happens.

question: Avery manifests the top card of their library with [Soul Summons]. Then, they mutate [Trumpeting Gnarr] targeting the manifested creature. What are the characteristics of the resulting creature if Avery chooses to put the manifested creature on top?
answer_gold: It is a 2/2 colorless face-down creature with no abilities. It is face-down because the topmost object is face-down, and this status defines its characteristics. This notably means that Trumpeting Gnarr's triggered ability won't trigger.

question: April casts [Spontaneous Flight] targeting their [Mist Dragon]. After that resolves April then activates its 'lose flying' ability. They cast another Spontaneous Flight targeting Mist Dragon. After that resolves they then use [Hex Parasite] to remove one flying counter. Does Mist Dragon have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. Keyword counters and ability-removing effects all apply in layer 6 in timestamp order. However when April put the second flying counter on Mist Dragon all flying counters on Mist Dragon had their timestamps updated to match the most recent counter. Meaning that the remaining flying counter on Mist Dragon has a newer timestamp than the activation of the ability that causes it to lose flying.

question: Avery casts [Vulpikeet] for its mutate cost, mutating under a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. They then cast [Rootborn Defenses], choosing to populate the merged permanent. What happens?
answer_gold: They will create a token that is a copy of the 1/1 red Goblin creature token with all abilities from Vulpikeet. To populate means to create a copy of a creature token the player controls. A mutated permanent has the characteristics of its topmost component, along with all abilities of each card and token that represents it, so it will be a token and can therefore be populated. ([702.140e], [729.2d]) This is a copyable effect, so the copy created when Avery populates the merged permanent will also have the characteristics of the Goblin token and the abilities from Vulpikeet.

question: Aimee controls [Fiend Artisan] and has four creature cards in their graveyard. Nico enchants it with [Mystic Subdual]. What is the power and toughness of Fiend Artisan?
answer_gold: Fiend Artisan is a -1/1. In layer 6 Mystic Subdual eliminates the abilities of Fiend Artisan. In layer 7 Mystic Subdual gives Fiend Artisan -2/-0, making it a -1/1. Its ability to gain +1/+1 from each creature card in Aimee's graveyard does not apply, as it was removed.

question: Ari controls [Xathrid Gorgon]. Neriah controls a [Hexavus] and [Stonehewer Giant]. Ari activates Xathrid Gorgon to put a petrification counter on Stonehewer Giant which Neriah removes with Hexavus. Can Neriah activate Stonehewer Giant's activated ability?
answer_gold: No, Neriah cannot activate Stonehewer Giant's ability. This is because the changes made by Xathrid Gorgon's ability are a continuous effect. The petrification counter serves only as a reminder of the changes and is not dependent on the counter. Stonehewer Giant will remain a defender that cannot activate it's abilities for the rest of the game.

question: Nico controls [Humility]. Avalyn controls [Maritime Guard] and wants to cast [Glowstone Recluse] mutating onto the Maritime Guard and putting it on top. What will the resulting creature's P/T be?
answer_gold: 1/1 with no abilities, since mutate impacts the creature in layer 1 and Humility acts in layers 6 and 7. It will also not trigger Glowstone Recluse because Humility applies constantly and it's never on the battlefield without being affected.

question: Alex controls [Magus of the Moon] and [Forgotten Monument]. Neil casts [Lizard, Connors's Curse] targeting Magus of the Moon. After Lizard, Connors's Curse has resolved, what are the characteristics of Forgotten Monument?
answer_gold: A Land - Mountain that can tap for {R} and no other types of mana. It's still named "Forgotten Monument". Magus of the Moon's ability applies in the type changing layer, layer 4. It doesn't lose that ability until layer 6, at which point the ability has already been applied.

question: Ainsley enchants their [Colossus Hammer] with [Rune of Flight]. Then they equip it to [Skeletal Snake]. Does Skeletal Snake have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. The ability granted by Rune of Flight has a later timestamp than the inherent ability of Colossus Hammer and will be applied second causing Skeletal Snake to gain flying after it has lost it. When Colossus Hammer becomes equipped it will gain a new timestamp, but the relative timestamps of both objects will remain the same.

question: Ashley equips [Colossus Hammer] to [Ogre Warrior], then enchants it with [Phantom Wings]. Does Ogre Warrior have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. The effects from Colossus Hammer and Phantom Wings apply in the same layer, and Phantom Wings has the more recent timestamp.

question: Ari controls [Magus of the Moon] enchanted with [Ichthyomorphosis]. Is Ari's [Dormant Volcano] a Mountain?
answer_gold: Yes. Continuous effects are applied in a specific order, and type-changing effects are applied before ability-removing effects.

question: Averie controls [Muraganda Petroglyphs] and [Wayward Angel], and has more than 7 cards in their graveyard. Nathan casts and resolves [Humility]. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics?
answer_gold:
Wayward Angel is a Black, 6/6 creature with no abilities. The rest of its characteristics remain the same as printed on the card. 
Wayward Angel's threshold ability changes both its color, abilities, and P/T. Therefore, it applies in layers 5, 6, and 7 with the appropriate parts applying in their appropriate layers, and the layers are applied in order. Similarly, Humility's effect is applied in layers 6 and 7, as appropriate. 
Applying layers in order:
- In layer 5, Wayward Angel becomes black. 
- In layer 6 there are two contending effects: Wayward Angel's ability giving it trample and an upkeep triggered ability, and Humility's ability removing all abilities from Wayward Angel. There is no dependency between the two, since Wayward Angel's ability has already started applying in a previous layer, and will continue to apply even if removed by Humility's ability. The effects are then applied in timestamp order with Wayward Angel's ability applying first, since it has an earlier timestamp. So in layer 6, Wayward Angel first gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature.", and then loses all abilities to Humility.
- In layer 7, P/T setting effects are applied first, so that Humility first turns Wayward Angel into a 1/1. Then effects modifying P/T are applied, of which there are two: Wayward Angel's own ability that, even though removed, continues to apply and gives it +3/+3, and Muraganda Petroglyphs's ability giving Wayward Angel +2/+2 since it now has no abilities. Wayward Angel's P/T is finally 6/6.

question: Nico controls [Urza's Saga] with two lore counters on it. Alexzander uses [Jinx] to change its land type. What happens?
answer_gold:
In layer 4, Urza's Saga will have its land type overwritten as well as lose all of its chapter abilities. It will gain the abilities to tap for {C} and to create Construct tokens in layer 6, as those abilities are granted by a continuous effect that was generated when the previous chapter abilities resolved..

Because Urza's Saga has lost all of its chapter abilities while still being a Saga, it is immediately sacrificed the next time state-based actions are checked, per the Urza's Saga ruling "If Urza's Saga loses all of its chapter abilities but is still a Saga, perhaps due to a card like Blood Moon, it will immediately be sacrificed".

question: Ari casts [Aeve, Progenitor Ooze], with two spells having been cast before then. Nadia controls [Humility]. What will Ari's battlefield look like once the stack fully resolves and state-based actions are checked?

question: Alex controls [Karametra, God of Harvests], and then casts [Opalescence]. Their devotion to white is 2. Is Karametra, God of Harvests a creature? If so, what is its power and toughness?

question: Aubree casts [Blood Moon]. Nikolas activates [Inkmoth Nexus]'s ability in response. What will Inkmoth Nexus look like after everything resolves? What will it look like next turn?

Removing the activated ability from Inkmoth Nexus does not affect the instance of the ability that has already resolved, so the effect will end as normal and Inkmoth Nexus will not be a creature next turn.
